parts.script:
Anna: Hey Mark, do you have any plans for this weekend?  
Mark: Not yet, I was thinking of going hiking if the weather is good. How about you?  
Anna: I’m planning to visit my parents. They live about two hours away.  
Mark: That sounds nice. Are you driving there?  
Anna: Yes, I’ll take my car. I haven’t seen them in a while.  
Mark: Do you have anything specific in mind for your visit?  
Anna: Just spending quality time together. We might go out for dinner at our favorite restaurant.  
Mark: That sounds great! I hope you have a lovely time. If I go hiking, I’ll probably take some sandwiches and water.  
Anna: Good idea! Do you have a specific trail in mind?  
Mark: Yes, I want to try that new trail they opened last month. I heard the view from the top is amazing!  
Anna: You should take some photos to show me later.  
Mark: Absolutely! Let’s catch up next week to share our weekend adventures.  
Anna: Deal!  
Mark: Have a safe trip to your parents!  
Anna: Thanks, you too! Enjoy your hike!

questions.question: What does Mark plan to do this weekend?
questions.explanation: Mark mentions that he is thinking of going hiking if the weather is good.

questions.question: Complete the form. Write no more than TWO WORDS.
questions.explanation: Anna is driving her car to visit her parents.

questions.question: What does Anna plan to do with her parents?
questions.explanation: Anna says she plans to spend quality time with her parents.
